kvariskov.title: Still in forest

kvariskov.name: Name
kvariskov.hint: Place the BSF8 check unit on the mini reader (inductive coupling) and click Read to see who is still in the forest.
kvariskov.instructions: How to read a check unit:
kvariskov.step1: 1. Wake the unit: dip an SI card into the check unit itself (it sleeps otherwise).
kvariskov.step2: 2. Place the unit on the mini reader (USB) — it couples inductively.
kvariskov.step3: 3. Click Read right after waking it (it falls asleep again after a while).
kvariskov.asleep: The check unit isn't responding — it's probably asleep. Dip an SI card into the unit to wake it, then click Read again.

prerace.noCard.title: Runners without a card
prerace.noCard.rule: The runner brings an own or rented card (TR 4.18.10).
prerace.noStart.title: Runners without a start time
prerace.noStart.rule: Applies to drawn classes, classes timed from the start time and age classes at level 1–3, where start times are drawn even when the time runs from the start punch (TR 7.4.2, TR 4.18.16).
prerace.noClub.title: Runners without a club
prerace.noClub.rule: The start list shows the club (TR 7.5.4). Club-less runners are listed too.
prerace.noName.title: Runners without a name
prerace.noName.rule: An entry without a name is not drawn (TR 7.5.1).
prerace.cardTooSmall.title: Card with too few slots for the course
prerace.cardTooSmall.rule: Every punch must be readable (TR 8.1.4). Switch to a larger card.
prerace.splitsMissing.title: Splits missing after 30
prerace.splitsMissing.rule: An SI5 stores the time for 30 punches, then only the control code. The course is still checked. A warning, not a fault.

settings.radio.unitsHelp: ROC sends the station's own code. Say which codes are start, check and finish, e.g. start 3, 13, check 2, 12, 22, finish 10, 20. A row with such a code is compared with the card's start, check or finish time from that very unit.
